title: feat(app-shell): the field inspector's Type control is a searchable picker grouped by category (objectui#11793)
body:
Fixes #11793
Clause-②: no

## What changes

Studio's field inspector chose a field type from one flat select of 46 rows ("Text · Text" … "Advanced · Vector"), with no search, no icon and nothing saying what a type is for. The *Type* control is now a searchable picker:

- **The trigger** shows the field's type by name, with the type's icon tinted by its category.
- **The list** groups the types under their category headings, in the Studio catalog's order (`TYPES_BY_CATEGORY`). Each row is the type's icon (`FIELD_TYPE_META`), its name (`engine.fieldType.*`) and a one-line description; the current type carries a check and is highlighted and scrolled into view on open. Each option is named by the type and described by its line (`aria-labelledby` / `aria-describedby`), so a screen reader does not read the two as one run.
- **Search** matches the type's name as shown, its category as shown, its id (`master_detail` also as `master detail`) and the catalog's English name, so a zh author finds 查找关系 by typing `lookup` or `Lookup`. Arrow keys and Enter choose without the mouse.

What stays as it was: a choice still goes to the inspector's `changeType` (so a retype to a type that cannot name a picklist still drops `picklist`); re-choosing the current type writes nothing; a read-only field keeps the control disabled; a stored type the catalog does not list is still shown under the designer's "(not found)" flag, never blank.

## How it is built

- `inspectors/FieldTypePicker.tsx`, module-private (imported by `ObjectFieldInspector` only, exported from no barrel). It composes `Popover` + `Command` (cmdk) from `@object-ui/components`, import only — the same parts the custom-layer `Combobox` and the sibling `InspectorComboField` are built from. `custom/combobox.tsx` itself did not fit, measured: one ungrouped list of labels, no icon or second line, and re-choosing its current value commits an empty string. Nothing under `packages/components` is touched.
- **Descriptions: 46 new `engine.fieldTypeDesc.*` rows, en and zh**, in the metadata-admin designer's own string table (`i18n.ts`, beside `engine.fieldType.*`). `@objectstack/spec` 17.7.0 carries no per-type description to read instead: `FieldType` is a bare `z.enum` with no `.describe()`, and `json-schema/data/FieldType.json` lists bare names (lit control: the same dist does carry `.describe('Relationship type')` on Studio's relationship-type enum). The search placeholder and empty text reuse the canvas Add-field palette's existing `designer.canvas.searchFieldType` / `designer.canvas.noMatchingTypes` rows.
- `buildTypeOptions` and its "Category · Type" strings are gone from `ObjectFieldInspector.tsx`.
- No export, prop, type member or language-pack key is added; `.changeset/11793-field-type-picker.md` is a `patch` on `@object-ui/app-shell`.

## Pins

`ObjectFieldInspector.typePicker-11793.test.tsx` mounts the real inspector in a host that applies its patches: the trigger shows the type and its icon and the list marks the current type; every catalog type is listed once under its category heading, in catalog order, each with an icon and its description; typing "look" leaves Lookup alone, under Relation; the search also matches a category and an id, and an unmatched query shows the empty text; choosing Email retypes the field (and `FieldSchema` accepts it); Enter after a search chooses the first match; a picklist-bound select retyped to Number drops `picklist`; re-choosing the current type writes nothing; a read-only field's trigger is disabled; an unlisted stored type reads `legacy_widget (not found)`; zh shows the zh names, headings and descriptions and still finds a type by an English word; every catalog type has a description row in both tables.

**Pin edits outside the original file surface, taken in under claim amendment 6053534326:** three studio-design tests picked a type by the retired row label with a regex ending `· Picklist`, `· Radio` or `· Lookup` (`DataPillar.authorRefusal-11785.test.tsx`, `DataPillar.choiceWithoutOptions-11253.test.tsx`, `DataPillar.heldIncomplete-11786.test.tsx`). Commit `5c63334` anchors each regex to the type's name (`/^Picklist$/`); no assertion changes meaning. `ObjectFieldInspector.usePicklist-10202.test.tsx` gets the same two-line change on the original surface. A census on `main` of the old label shape (a type name after ` · ` in `*.ts`, `*.tsx`, `*.mjs`, `*.md`) hits exactly those four test files.

## Verification (head `81c21f4`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/` plus the two inspector pin files: Test Files 124 passed (124), Tests 795 passed.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/`: Test Files 143 passed (143), Tests 1908 passed, 1 skipped — measured at `c43b003`; the merge to `81c21f4` touched no file under `inspectors/`.
- The other tests that name the inspector (`apps/console` `preview-samples-designer-options`, `preview-samples-spec-valid`; `packages/fields` `optionWidgets.emptyLabel`): 3 files, 50 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (both projects; `tsconfig.test.json` lists the new picker and both inspector test files) exit 0, after a turbo build of the `@object-ui/app-shell^...` closure.
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the 8 touched source and test files: 0 errors (11 pre-existing `no-explicit-any` warnings on `ObjectFieldInspector` lines this diff does not touch).
- `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:icon-record-names`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unused-deps`, the three `check:vi-mock-*`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:self-import`, `check:metadata-write-doors`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`: all exit 0. The designer-parity gate prints "Every en row has a zh row, and every shared row carries the same placeholders."; the drift gate counts 46 keys added and no en value changed.

**Declared narrowing.** The whole-package run `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/` (1123 test files) was not run locally: it does not fit the container's foreground limit on a shared 4-core box. The local runs cover `metadata-admin/` (all 426 files, before the `main` merges) and `studio-design/`; every test file that names `ObjectFieldInspector`, `FieldTypePicker` or `engine.fieldType` is among them, and the label census above bounds the tests that drove the old control. CI runs the whole package.

**Ablation (one-shot, nothing kept).** Through `ablation-replace` on `FieldTypePicker.tsx`, the search filter's `if (!query) return true;` became `return true;` (anchor hit once, blob changed): the typePicker pins went 4 failed, 8 passed. The "look" pin read `expected [ 'text', 'textarea', 'email', …(43) ] to deeply equal [ 'lookup' ]`; the other three red pins are the search ones, the eight green ones are not. The restore was proven by blob equality with `HEAD` and an empty `git diff HEAD`. The test reaches the picker by relative import, so no `dist` is in the path.

**Browser reading.** No Studio backend was booted; the console preview gallery (`preview-gallery.html?only=object`) on a private Vite port, driven by Playwright with the pre-installed Chromium, in en-US and zh-CN. Selecting *Order Name* shows the trigger as Text / 单行文本 with its icon. Opening it shows 9 headings in catalog order and 46 rows, the current row checked and highlighted. The Lookup row reads "Lookup — A link to a record of another object." and "查找关系 — 关联到另一个对象的一条记录。". Typing `look` leaves Lookup alone, Enter retypes the field (trigger and canvas badge read Lookup / 查找关系), two ArrowDown presses move the highlight, Escape closes. No page errors.

## Acceptance notes

- **Catalog drift, filed as objectstack-ai/objectui#11909, not this PR's.** Studio's catalog (`previews/field-types.ts`) lists 46 types while `@objectstack/spec` 17.7.0's `FieldType` has 49 (`secret`, `user`, `record` are missing). A one-shot probe through the real inspector read the Type trigger as `user (not found)` (likewise `secret`, `record`), with none of the three offered; `examples/app-showcase` in objectstack declares such fields. The flat select drew the same flag from the same catalog; this PR keeps that flag.
- **Observation, not filed.** `InspectorComboField` and the components-layer `Combobox` render cmdk's search input without passing `Command`'s `label`, so the input is named through an empty `aria-labelledby`. This was measured only on this picker, before it passed its own label (Testing Library found no input by its placeholder name); it was not measured on those two components.
